info.name: BigCommerce Abandoned Cart Emails Search Filters API

items.docs: Returns a list of enabled default [Product Filtering](https://support.bigcommerce.com/s/article/Product-Filtering-Settings) filters. These filters will be used if a store does not have contextual overrides.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Narrows the list of available filters based on channel ID. Only products currently assigned to the given Channel will be considered.

params.name: category_id
params.description: Narrows the list of available filters based on category ID. You can display settings to show products from the provided category, subcategories only, or both the category and its child categories.

items.docs: Returns a list of filters available to power [Product Filtering](https://support.bigcommerce.com/s/article/Product-Filtering-Settings).

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Only return contextual overrides related to a particular Channel.

params.name: category_id
params.description: Only return contextual overrides related to a particular Category.

items.docs:
Returns a list of contextual filters enabled for a particular channel or category.

**Usage Notes**

Contextual filters allow you to configure the enabled filters per channel or category, so that shoppers can filter by the most relevant criteria.

The order of the returned filters will match the sort order of the filters on the storefront.

Upserts contextual filters for a particular channel or category.

**Usage Notes**

Contextual filters allow you to configure the enabled filters per channel or category, so that shoppers can filter by the most relevant criteria.

You can change the order of the filters on the live site by changing the order of the filters you send.
